description.en: Repairs fused tool-call argument text at the llm/stream seam and re-throws whatever it cannot prove; names the deterministic refusals it will not retry at agent/request-error; answers per failure class which patch covers it and whether that patch is switched on here; reads multi-frame zstd session logs offline.
description.zh: 在 llm/stream 接缝上修复粘连的工具调用参数，证不出来的原样抛回；在 agent/request-error 上命名它不重试的确定性拒绝；按失败类回答哪个补丁覆盖它、以及它在本 profile 里是否启用；离线读取多帧 zstd 会话日志。
